counterProjection.purpose: Diagnostic only: removing the explicit future ammo counter consumer; never source admission

progressContract.sourceCounter: Exactly one AbilityEventCounter is attached to the same GameObject as a single direct RangedAttack in the selected mode. All serialized counter fields must match this source schema.
progressContract.nativeEnumAndGetter: AbilityStandard.Event 4=ON_SPELL_ON is verified from cached metadata. currentProgressSource/_FetchCounterSource/OnEvent/OnCountEvent native entries are protected; stopped after the bounded check. Accepted primary action mapping remains Inferred.
progressContract.simulationMapping: One bullet is consumed for each accepted primary attack action after launch/target acquisition. Failed acquisition, cast acceptance itself, individual targets and eventual impacts do not independently consume bullets.
progressContract.rawVersusEffective: Only fromMainRawAttack=0 is admitted. Raw=1, nested AbilityFirstSucceedGroup and an unrelated explicit progressSource remain rejected.

root: ClientPrograms validate ammo_count controller and positive integral source count
Allow until_detach Buff with zero skill.duration only under this finite ammo controller
ClientPrograms.duration returns finite serializable Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER for the ammo controller
Existing engine castSkill initializes count, accepted attack consumeOperatorAmmo notifies garrison, empty/death/manual end clears mode/Buffs; no second ammo counter
selectorAgent: secondaryFilter1 exact metadata = RANGED_APPLYWAY_FIRST; SourceApplyWay RANGED=2/ALL=3 bits, never position/flying
Attribute20 exact metadata TAUNT_LEVEL, addition -1 feeds shared target-priority consumers

validationPlan: 20 source-level real cast/attack/exhaustion and original attack restored
No-target and failed shot do not consume; multihit/target only accepted action once; final in-flight body survives expiry with frozen damage
SP stays locked through final ammo consumption; garrison ammo notifications exactly once per consumed round
Air-priority and ranged-weapon-priority shared contract fixtures; lower enemy target priority through source attr20
Actual available ordinary/elite season bindings and mid-ammo / final-shot host recovery
Unknown counter/controller/source levels and raw=1 reject
boundary: Source fields and same-object counter graph are verified; applying current CN levels to JP graph retains cross-snapshot inference.
Manual stop uses existing skill lifecycle API; no new UI control is introduced in this design.
Lemuen candidates keep all earlier rejection reasons; schema similarity alone does not authorize their source progress or marked-target behavior.
